source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polygenic inheritance and epistasis (PDF 96, 98).

blocks.text: Polygenic inheritance aur epistasis Mendel ke virasat ke andaaz se hatne ki mazeed misalein hain. Dono mein aik se zyada genes shamil hain, lekin dono alag tareeqe se kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Maloomat: polygenes aur epistasis ka muqabla
blocks.text: Polygenic inheritance mein bohat se genes mil kar, har aik chhota sa asar dalte hue, khasiyat banate hain, jis se musalsal (continuous) variation aati hai. Epistasis mein aik allele doosre gene ka asar chhupata ya badalta hai, jis se aam taur par ghair musalsal (discontinuous) variation aati hai, yaani khasiyat ki alag alag qismein.

blocks.prompt: In do mein se aam taur par musalsal variation kaun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Polygenic inheritance; epistasis aam taur par alag alag qismein deta hai.

items: Polygenes: bohat se genes jama, musalsal variation.
Epistasis: aik gene doosre ko chhupata, alag qismein.
